title: Lenses make many points: Pure point spectrum disproves Simon's $L^2$ conjecture
body_text:
Lenses make many points: Pure point spectrum disproves Simon's $L^2$ conjecture

For every $d\ge2$ and $0\leσ<1/3$, we construct with LLM-assistance a smooth bounded nonnegative lens-type potential $V$ with arbitrarily small $\|V\|_\infty+\int_{\mathbb{R}^d}|x|^{1-d+σ}|V(x)|^2 dx$, such that $-Δ+V$ has only pure point spectrum in $(0,\infty)$. Thus, we show that Barry Simon's $L^2$ conjecture, Problem 8 in "Schrödinger operators in the twenty-first century", is false.

Authors: Simon Becker, Mengxuan Yang
Categories: math.SP, math-ph, math.SP
